pins.name: GPIO8
pins.label: GPIO8
pins.notes:
PIN_M1A — DC motor driver 1, channel A (PWM4A). Onboard 4-channel H-bridge motor driver output (3A continuous / 5A peak per channel, per Cytron's product page). Ordinary PWM-capable GPIO — drive directly via digitalWrite/analogWrite to control motor 1, matching Cytron's own dc_motor example code. No D-alias in this board's pins_arduino.h (see its own pfodWeb NOTE comment); added here so the Designer's pin picker surfaces it with a clear identity label.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D20
pins.label: GPIO20 (Button)
pins.notes: Onboard user pushbutton 1 ("USER BUTTON" per vendor pinout diagram; unaliased in this board's pins_arduino.h, only plain D20). Active-low with internal pull-up — confirmed via Cytron's official Arduino button.ino example (pinMode(20, INPUT_PULLUP); if (!digitalRead(btn1))).

pins.name: D21
pins.label: GPIO21 (Button)
pins.notes: Onboard user pushbutton 2 ("USER BUTTON" per vendor pinout diagram; unaliased in this board's pins_arduino.h, only plain D21). Active-low with internal pull-up — confirmed via Cytron's official Arduino button.ino example (pinMode(21, INPUT_PULLUP); if (!digitalRead(btn2))).

pins.name: D23
pins.label: GPIO23 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL / PIN_RGB — onboard 2-pixel WS2812 "RGB LED", output-only. Confirmed via the vendor pinout diagram ("RGB LED -> GP23"), this board's own NUM_NEOPIXEL=2, and the product page's "2 x RGB LED (Neopixel compatible)" spec.

pins.name: D24
pins.label: D24 (GPIO24)
pins.notes: PIN_USB_HOST_DP — onboard native USB Type-A HOST connector D+ line, confirmed via the vendor pinout diagram ("USB HOST: D+ -> GP24") and product page ("direct USB host to connect USB joystick or gamepad"). Dedicated hardware, not general purpose — has a D24 alias in this board's pins_arduino.h that would otherwise expose it as an ordinary full-capability digital pin.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: D25 (GPIO25)
pins.notes: PIN_USB_HOST_DM — onboard native USB Type-A HOST connector D- line. Same reasoning as GPIO24.
